title: NVIDIA expands sovereign AI infrastructure partnerships
content: NVIDIA reported strong demand for AI training and inference platforms. Management highlighted record data center demand, expanded sovereign AI partnerships, and upside from next-generation GPU shipments.

title: Snowflake sees improving cloud consumption trends
content: Snowflake highlighted strong cloud consumption, better large-customer expansion, and a new partnership around AI data products. Management sees demand acceleration in enterprise cloud workloads.

title: CrowdStrike discloses elevated support pressure after outage review
content: CrowdStrike said demand remains healthy, but the company disclosed support pressure after a customer outage review. Management noted execution risk, regulatory questions, and a slower expansion motion in part of the installed base.

title: Arm launches new CPU roadmap for AI edge and data center devices
content: Arm announced a new CPU roadmap for AI edge devices and data center platforms. The launch expands semiconductor demand and strengthens its role in efficient AI compute.
